title: Mozilla to UK regulators: VPNs are essential privacy and security tools
summary: Mozilla submitted comments to UK regulators advocating for VPN services as essential privacy and security tools, warning that regulatory actions could undermine these critical protections for users. The company emphasizes that VPNs play a vital role in protecting digital rights and enabling safe internet access.
problem_solved: Addresses potential regulatory threats to VPN services that could compromise user privacy and security in the UK.
